Specification: This module contains TLAPS proofs for safety-related theorems of a voting/Paxos-style specification imported from the module Voting. It proves helper facts about quorums and choosability, and then proves a central safety theorem showing that if the invariant Inv holds and a quorum shows safety at ballot b for value v, then SafeAt(b, v) holds. The file is proof-oriented rather than operational: it introduces no variables or actions of its own, and focuses on structured proofs using assumptions, quorum intersection arguments, ballot arithmetic, and invariant expansion.
TheoremNames: THEOREM AllSafeAtZero_T == \A v \in Value : SafeAt(0, v)

THEOREM ChoosableThm_T ==
    \A b \in Ballot, v \in Value : ChosenAt(b, v) => NoneOtherChoosableAt(b, v)

LEMMA OneValuePerBallotApply ==
  ASSUME OneValuePerBallot,
         NEW a1 \in Acceptor, NEW a2 \in Acceptor, NEW bb \in Ballot,
         NEW v1 \in Value, NEW v2 \in Value,
         VotedFor(a1, bb, v1), VotedFor(a2, bb, v2)
  PROVE  v1 = v2

LEMMA QuorumIntersect ==
  ASSUME NEW Q1 \in Quorum, NEW Q2 \in Quorum
  PROVE  \E a \in Q1 \cap Q2 : a \in Acceptor

THEOREM ShowsSafety_T ==
    Inv => \A Q \in Quorum, b \in Ballot, v \in Value :
              ShowsSafeAt(Q, b, v) => SafeAt(b, v)
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME OneValuePerBallot,
         NEW a1 \in Acceptor, NEW a2 \in Acceptor, NEW bb \in Ballot,
         NEW v1 \in Value, NEW v2 \in Value,
         VotedFor(a1, bb, v1), VotedFor(a2, bb, v2)
  PROVE  v1 = v2

ASSUME NEW Q1 \in Quorum, NEW Q2 \in Quorum
  PROVE  \E a \in Q1 \cap Q2 : a \in Acceptor

ASSUME NEW b \in Ballot, NEW v \in Value, ChosenAt(b, v)
               PROVE  NoneOtherChoosableAt(b, v)

ASSUME Inv,
                      NEW Q \in Quorum, NEW b \in Ballot, NEW v \in Value,
                      ShowsSafeAt(Q, b, v)
               PROVE  SafeAt(b, v)

ASSUME NEW c0 \in 0..(b-1)
                PROVE  NoneOtherChoosableAt(c0, v)

ASSUME NEW a \in Q,
                         ~ DidNotVoteAt(a, c)
                  PROVE  VotedFor(a, c, v)
